detail.title: Investigation into Metareasoning Mechanisms and Architecture Limitations
detail.summary: This proposal continues our empirical and theoretical examination of unrecognized reasoning limits under the selected topic unrecognized_reasoning_limits, focusing on project proj-reasoning-limits-001. We formulate a structured hypothesis regarding metareasoning error detection in cognitive architectures, supported by collected evidence.
